answer: Each identity enters the sable registry, locks 60 credits as bond, and pays a mint fee into the zephyr bounty pool. The fee rises with the mint count: the k-th pays 30+4(k-1), first 30, 1000th 4026; with bond and 20 work, the k-th fake costs 110+4(k-1). A juniper auditor re-derives every record; a reused or mismatched record burns the bond and pays the auditor a bounty. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its bond. 1000 fakes cost 2108000: 60000 bonds, 2028000 fees, 20000 work. A rented-record ring fails: re-derivation catches the shared record and burns it.
